Each is `leg = 'operator'`, fired once through `--operator {n}` and never re-run. The rig makes the record   (`evidence/survey-starts.ndjson`). Each entry asserts the folder's removal and the cap's ledger. S1–S3's readings   are report-shaped facts the step 4 card reads; S5's are asserted, and S6's where it is fired.   - Entry 18 is fired only when entry 17's summary reads `shown: no`. The atomic flag and   the feed thread are Linux-only by the tree, so no other leg exists and no other reading is owed. - **Controls, each one-shot through `gate.py control`** (gate-contract §Control), each with `--timeout 300` on its   filtered entry, its case by name. «holds» = the named cases ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line (`inputs#I1`   item 3).   - `survey-flag` — entry 6. Case: `observed_a_neighbour_of_a_survey_key_under_the_flag_takes_the_wheel`.   - `survey-poison` — entry 6. Guard: the feed thread's `false` on a poisoned model (removed: the flag keeps its last     value). Case: `feed_panic_clears_the_survey_flag`.   - `survey-options` — entry 5. Guard: `survey_standing`'s options-row literal check (removed: the prompt literal     alone stands). Case: `survey_standing_reads_both_literals_and_no_poison`.
